body:
**<sub><sub>![P2 Badge](https://img.shields.io/badge/P2-yellow?style=flat)</sub></sub>  Synchronize updates to the shared state store**

Because `@st.cache_resource` exposes this dictionary to every Streamlit session, two concurrent reruns can interleave these separate `clear()` and `update()` calls. If another session copies the store after the clear, its subsequent update rebuilds it from only its three-day window and permanently discards remembered offline validators; a session holding an older cached `df` can likewise overwrite newer versions. Protect the read/merge/write operation with a shared lock and make it monotonic by last-ping date.

AGENTS.md reference: [AGENTS.md:L94-L99](https://github.com/raphastark/dashboard-rollout-validadores/blob/ee2c081c07caa6f98870f9f1088508a91c07b5bd/AGENTS.md#L94-L99)

body:
**<sub><sub>![P2 Badge](https://img.shields.io/badge/P2-yellow?style=flat)</sub></sub>  Include remembered builds in the version filter**

When a validator retained in `state` has been offline long enough that its build no longer occurs in the fresh three-day `df`, this call adds its row to the inventory but the selector above is still populated exclusively from `df["versao_app"]`. Consequently, that remembered build is visible in the table but cannot be selected by the version filter; build the options from the completed inventory/state and order them with `_version_key`.

body:
**WARNING:** Recent activity is lost when a validator changes vehicles

The inventory now collapses each validator to its latest `id_veiculo`, but `activity_for` still looks up history by the `(id_veiculo, id_validador)` pair. If a validator moved from vehicle A to B during the displayed window, its row keeps B and renders white dots for every ping previously made on A, so the activity timeline is incorrect. Aggregate activity by validator or combine all of its vehicle pairs.

---
Reply with `@kilocode-bot fix it` to have Kilo Code address this issue.
